text: I can explain why internal service traffic needs TLS or mTLS and spot a client that encrypts without verifying the certificate.
I can say which attacker disk, database and field-level encryption each defend against, and which they don't.
I can draw envelope encryption with a KMS-held KEK and wrapped DEKs, and explain cheap KEK rotation.
I can compute the KMS request cost of a read path and size a data key cache, stating the revocation delay it adds.
I can design how a service gets short-lived credentials via workload identity, and respond correctly to a leaked secret.
I can plan PII handling for a feature: minimisation, tokenization or HMAC pseudonyms, log redaction and erasure across backups.
